description: Three commands install Tailscale, bring up the interface with browser sign-in, and print the stable 100.x tailnet address that other devices use to reach this machine.

steps.description: Line 1 runs the install script (macOS and Windows have installers instead). Line 2 authenticates via browser. Line 3 prints the machine's tailnet IPv4 address.
Line 3 outputs a stable address like 100.92.14.7 that does not change; write it down for SSH from other devices.

steps.question: What does the tailscale ip -4 command print?

title: Tailscale Setup for Tailnet Access
